input.summary: Meridian carries 23 active, unmitigated risks spanning lakehouse, governance, AI, and payment integrity — all blocking use-case advancement.
covers: Governed data foundation for AI / LLM automation
sources: MER-V3-EVID-0170 through MER-V3-EVID-0197 (28 primary evidence refs)
MER-SA07-INT-EVID-0001 through MER-SA07-INT-EVID-0012 (12 interview evidence refs)
Epic Clarity; Epic Caboodle; Claims administration platform; Pharmacy claims platform
SAS analytics estate; SQL Server reporting marts; Tableau; Power BI; Provider contract repository

story.meaning: Meridian's seven strategic use cases share a common risk root: no certified data foundation, no formal governance, and no AI audit trail — making every downstream value claim ungated.
story.observed: 23 active risk items span four structural failure modes: no medallion architecture, no identity spine, no semantic layer, and no governed model lineage. All seven use cases are blocked at the evidence gate.
story.matters: Without closing these risks, Meridian cannot advance from planning to execution on any priority use case — lakehouse, AI automation, cost transparency, or payment integrity all stall at the same foundation gap.
story.supports: Risk register (249 rows, 23 active) is source-backed at 89% confidence. Evidence refs MER-V3-EVID-0170–0197 and MER-SA07-INT-EVID-0001–0012 corroborate each active item.

findings: No certified medallion architecture and no patient/member identity spine are the single highest-leverage blockers — resolving both unlocks the lakehouse use case and four downstream dependencies simultaneously.

The absence of a formal data governance operating model and AI audit trail creates regulatory and model-risk exposure across all AI/LLM use cases; no use case can reach production without these controls in place.

Provider contract terms are not in governed digital form and SAS payment integrity model lineage is ungoverned — together these two gaps prevent cost transparency and leakage quantification from reaching decision grade.

Call center optimization is blocked by four concurrent gaps: transcript governance, real-time integration, intent taxonomy certification, and member identity linkage — none of which are individually sufficient alone.

breakdown.title: Active Risk Distribution by Use Case Domain

rows.label: Unified Clinical + Claims Lakehouse
rows.note: Medallion architecture, identity spine, claims/pharmacy harmonization, AWS/Databricks foundation

rows.label: Governed Data Foundation / AI-LLM
rows.note: No formal governance, no semantic layer, no AI audit trail, data quality rules absent

rows.label: Call Center Optimization
rows.note: Transcript governance, real-time integration, intent taxonomy, member identity linkage

rows.label: Provider Quality & Cost Transparency
rows.note: Attribution, contract linkage, contract digitization, GL alignment, cost allocation, margin model

rows.label: Payment Integrity & Automated Close
rows.note: Model lineage, entity resolution, investigation workflow, recovery tracking, finance semantic layer

chain: risks → gaps (each active risk maps directly to an unresolved architectural or governance gap)
risks → use_cases (all 7 use cases are gated by at least one active risk item)
risks → evidence (244 evidence refs underpin risk register; low evidence density = higher residual risk)
risks → data_assets (Epic Clarity, Claims, SAS estate, Provider contract repository are the primary risk-bearing systems)
risks → roadmap (no use case can exit planning stage until its blocking risks are closed and evidence gates are passed)
relationships.note: Risks are not isolated compliance items — they form a dependency chain where foundation risks (medallion, identity spine, governance) cascade into every use-case risk. Closing the top four foundation risks would structurally de-risk the majority of the active register.

gaps.missing: No certified medallion architecture or patient/member identity spine
gaps.blocks: Unified clinical + claims lakehouse cannot produce a governed longitudinal view; all population health and cost analytics are ungated
gaps.needed: Epic Clarity and Caboodle medallion certification + identity spine load evidence on AWS/Databricks target state
gaps.handoff: Data Engineering and CDAO office must certify architecture before lakehouse use case exits planning

gaps.missing: No formal data governance operating model and no AI audit trail
gaps.blocks: All AI/LLM automation use cases are blocked; model risk and regulatory exposure is unquantified
gaps.needed: Governance operating model charter + AI audit trail implementation + data quality rule evidence
gaps.handoff: CDAO and Compliance must co-own governance model; CIO must confirm audit trail tooling before any AI use case advances

gaps.missing: Provider contract terms not digitized in governed form; attribution ownership unproven
gaps.blocks: End-to-end cost transparency and provider quality use cases cannot reach decision grade
gaps.needed: Governed contract digitization + attribution logic certification + provider contract linkage to claims
gaps.handoff: Network Contracting and Finance must validate contract data; Analytics must certify attribution rules

gaps.missing: SAS payment integrity model lineage ungoverned; provider entity resolution unproven
gaps.blocks: Leakage quantification and recovery realization tracking are not possible; FWA detection is unauditable
gaps.needed: SAS model lineage documentation + provider entity resolution certification + investigation and recovery workflow evidence
gaps.handoff: Health Plan Ops and Finance must jointly own lineage governance; Analytics must certify entity resolution before leakage claims are made

gaps.missing: Transcript governance, real-time CRM integration, and intent taxonomy not certified
gaps.blocks: Call center optimization cannot advance to agent-assist or next-best-action; member experience baseline is unmeasured
gaps.needed: Transcript governance policy + real-time integration proof + intent taxonomy certification + member identity linkage
gaps.handoff: Contact Center Ops, Legal/Privacy, and CRM platform owners must jointly close all four gaps before agent-assist piloting begins

evidence.name: Risks & Controls Register — Active Items
evidence.facts: 23 active risks span all 7 strategic use cases. Confidence: 179 high, 70 medium. 89% overall confidence score. No active risk has a certified mitigating control on record.
evidence.fields: use_case, risk_or_gap, affected_systems, confidence, active_candidate_status, metric_boundary, evidence_id
evidence.supports: Confirms breadth and severity of unmitigated risk across Meridian's entire use-case portfolio
evidence.missing: Risk owner assignments are absent; no target remediation dates or control effectiveness ratings are recorded

evidence.name: Lakehouse Foundation Risk Bundle
evidence.facts: No certified medallion architecture; no patient/member identity spine loaded; claims and pharmacy harmonization unproven; AWS/Databricks foundation not ready. All four are high or medium confidence.
evidence.supports: Establishes that the lakehouse use case has zero certified foundation components in place
evidence.missing: No architecture decision record or platform readiness assessment is referenced

evidence.name: AI / LLM Governance Risk Bundle
evidence.facts: No formal data governance operating model; no certified semantic layer; no AI audit trail evidence; data quality rules absent. All four are high or medium confidence.
evidence.supports: Confirms that AI/LLM use cases carry unmitigated model risk and regulatory exposure with no current control evidence
evidence.missing: No governance charter, stewardship RACI, or audit trail tooling selection is evidenced

evidence.name: Call Center Optimization Risk Bundle
evidence.facts: Transcript governance absent; real-time CRM integration unproven; intent taxonomy not certified; member identity linkage not proven. Three of four are high confidence.
evidence.supports: Confirms call center optimization is blocked by four concurrent, interdependent gaps — none individually sufficient to unblock the use case
evidence.missing: No baseline AHT, containment rate, or FCR data is loaded; no privacy review for transcript analytics is evidenced

evidence.name: Provider Quality, Cost Transparency & Payment Integrity Risk Bundle
evidence.rows: 12 active risk items across 3 use cases
evidence.facts: Measure logic fragmented across Tableau and Power BI; attribution unproven; contract terms undigitized; GL calendar misalignment; SAS model lineage ungoverned; provider entity resolution unproven; recovery tracking absent.
evidence.supports: Confirms that cost, quality, and payment integrity use cases share overlapping data and contract risks requiring coordinated remediation
evidence.missing: No finance sign-off on cost allocation rules; no actuarial validation of margin model; no SAS model inventory is referenced

visual_blocks.title: Meridian Risk Gate: Use Case vs. Foundation Control Status
visual_blocks.subtitle: Each cell = control evidence status. Red = absent. Amber = unproven. Decision: no use case exits planning until its row is green.
